facts.quote: from the Early Jurassic of southern Africa
This dinosaur was probably a herbivore (plant-eater)

facts.text: Pazour na palci sloužil pravděpodobně k trhání rostlin nebo stahování větví.
facts.quote: it bore a sharp thumb claw that was probably used in feeding, possibly to uproot vegetation or to pull down branches while rearing up

facts.text: Tento druh měřil na délku 4 až 6 metrů.
Skořápka vajec byla tenčí než 0,1 milimetru.
facts.quote: The eggshell was extremely thin, less than 0.1 mm

facts.text: Růst se zrychloval nebo zpomaloval podle toho, kolik bylo potravy.
facts.quote: Individuals accelerated or slowed down their growth depending on environmental factors such as food availability.
